title: CacheEntry
description: Minimal schema describing the conceptual shape of a cache entry. Adapters (Redis, in-memory, etc.) serialize the value field as they please; this schema documents the invariants both implementations rely on.

key.description: Cache key produced by the algorithm in rules/cache-key.md.

value.description: The cached value. Any JSON-representable value is permitted, including null/0/empty-string/false. Per D-B, adapters MUST distinguish 'absent key' from 'cached null' by returning the CACHE_MISS sentinel for the former.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds. 0 means 'no expiry' (adapter-specific behavior may vary).
